note: Frozen A/B corpus. Do not edit these strings - the whole point is that every release's numbers are comparable to every other release's. Add new briefs with new ids instead of rewording existing ones.
rules: One sentence per brief, no design direction in the prompt: the point is what the model reaches for unprompted.
Both arms get the same brief and the same model settings.
The 'with' arm has the Inspo MCP connected and NOTHING else - no other MCP, no skills.
The 'without' arm has no MCP and no skills.
Each arm writes one standalone HTML file; judge at 1280x800 (the fold the hero guidance targets).

briefs.subject: Driftmail, email automation for indie developers
briefs.prompt: Build a landing page for Driftmail, an email automation tool for indie developers.

rubric: Does the hero fit 1280x800 with nav, headline, supporting line and CTA all complete? (the single most common failure)
Is the type system deliberate - a real pairing and ramp, not one font at three sizes?
Does the palette read as a chosen brand rather than default blue-on-white?
Is the page shape a recognisable macrostructure, or an undifferentiated stack of centred sections?
Deliverable hygiene: meta charset present, no mojibake, no broken layout below the fold.
